requirements: Completed fixture identity and final score
Both teams' shots, shots on target, possession, corners and fouls
Eleven identified starters and a formation for each team
Timed event timeline with a reconciled final goal sequence
Timed, attributed shot map with xG and locations, reconciled to shot totals
eventPolicy.historyPolicy: Rolling windows and previous-match comparisons are unavailable across known missing/incomplete event fixtures, rather than skipping to older games. Elo uses the unique eligible history. Fixtures absent from all sources remain a coverage limitation.

meta.methodology: Only fixtures passing the detailed-event checks are indexed: both XIs/formations, core team statistics including xG, a reconciled event timeline and shot map. Weather and player market values are optional and may be missing. Rolling windows and previous-match comparisons are unavailable across known incomplete/missing-event fixtures, never silently extended to older games. Elo uses only unique eligible event fixtures; source fixture omissions remain a limitation. Flat 1-unit stakes. Maximum closing bookmaker odds preferred, opening maximum fallback when closing is missing. Betfair exchange fallback uses the last recorded price strictly before kickoff, at most 10 minutes old; commission is applied to winning exchange profit at the selected rate. No kickoff/in-play or Polymarket prices. Rolling form is within competition and season; opening fixtures remain in the pool but cannot match filters requiring unavailable history. Calendar-year leagues use the season bucket starting in that year. Coverage varies by competition, season and market; missing odds are excluded from returns.
